messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT - API gateway (ingress) is seeing a spike in 502/504 responses across multiple edge nodes (start 13:42 UTC). Auto-pager triggered to #incidents and on-call.

sophia: i'm oncall, looking at edge dashboard + logs now. pulling up recent deploys and ASG metrics.

james: confirmed spike. 502 rate jumped ~2% globally, concentrated in us-east-1 (~6% at peak). total requests failing ~1.6k/min.

maria: 13:39 deploy to ingress-controller (v2.7.3) completed across us-east; correlates with onset.

kevin: quick tail on ingress logs shows repeated `UpstreamReset` and `read: connection reset by peer` from upstream pool infer-gw.

sophia: starting mitigations: 1) divert traffic away from affected region 2) pause new ingress rollouts 3) scale upstream pool 4) consider rollback.

sophia: routing change to shift traffic away from us-east-1 to us-west-2 for immediate mitigation.

sophia: `rbctl traffic set-weight --service api-gateway --from-region us-east-1 --to-region us-west-2 --percent 100 --reason "502 surge"`

ops-bot: Deploybot suggests rollback to ingress-controller v2.7.2 (3 failures in 5m). Recommendation queued.

james: running pod log grab: `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/ingress-controller -l app=ingress --since=10m` - seeing upstream resets + a handful of `502 Bad Gateway - upstream prematurely closed connection`.

maria: i'll hold the rollback until we see whether routing shift reduces impact. want to avoid flip-flopping.

kevin: checked host-level metrics: upstream instances hit CPU saturation and connection queueing at incident start; autoscaler queued scale but not yet in effect.

luis: tcpdump shows RST from upstream worker processes after 1.2s idle; upstream app stack reporting queue overflow in logs.

sophia: scaling upstream pool now: `scaler scale service infer-gw --region us-east-1 --delta +30% --reason "502 surge"`

james: applied temporary client retry rule for 502/504 to reduce surface-level errors for clients.

sophia: `config push retries --route /v1/* --codes 502,504 --retries 2 --backoff 150ms-800ms` (applied)

ops-bot: Route change applied (change-id ch_4592) by sophia. Propagation ~30s.

maria: after routing and scaling, 502 rate in us-east dropped from 6% to ~0.5% within 2m. global rate down to 0.3%.

james: p95 latency is still 2x baseline in the window; root cause likely queuing/backpressure in upstream workers causing intermittent resets.

kevin: starting controlled rollback of ingress-controller to v2.7.2 for us-east only (canary style). will monitor.

maria: rollback command: `deployctl rollback ingress-controller --to-tag v2.7.2 --region us-east-1 --strategy canary` (initiated)

kevin: after canary rollback, logs show reduced connection resets for canary pods. metrics improving on canary traffic slice.

sophia: hold global rollback for now. keep traffic shift and incremental rollback until stable for 15m.

luis: saving relevant logs and traces to /var/incident/3658907531/ (edge logs, upstream logs, deploy diffs, autoscaler events).

sophia: customer-impact estimate: james, what's our rough user-facing impact number?

james: using sampling and service-graphs: ~1.8% of requests in us-east returned 502/504 during the peak 10m window. High-priority API customers saw higher error ratios (3-4x baseline). No platform-wide data corruption.

maria: notifying CS and Sales with a short blast: immediate mitigation in place; postmortem to follow. tagging top 10 customers in affected regions.

sophia: handoff plan: i'll keep monitoring for 30m, then hand to james for overnight watch if stable.

james: ack. i'll monitor dashboards and traces and escalate if error delta >0.5% persists for 5m.

kevin: followup action: revisit autoscaler headroom and scale triggers for infer-gw to avoid cold failure under burst CPU.

maria: postmortem owner assigned: maria. will collect deploy diffs, tracer spans, autoscaler events, and the canary results.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-3489, severity: sev2. Postmortem requested and owner assigned.

sophia: thanks team — incident downgraded to monitoring. leaving notes in ticket and adding runbook tweaks.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Scheduled heartbeat pings to #incidents for 2h and pager checks every 15m.

sophia: all clear for now; handing off fully to james. :thumbsup:
